test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Who among the following served as the first Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hiralal Jekisundas Kania.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hiralal Jekisundas Kania** was the** first Chief Justice of India,** holding office from **1950 to 1951**.
 
• Before his tenure as Chief Justice, Kania served as a** judge on the Federal Court of India,** the highest court in India from **1937 to 1950.**
 
• When India became a republic on **January 26, 1950,** Kania was appointed the first Chief Justice of the newly formed Supreme Court of India.
 
• As Chief Justice, Kania read the oath to the first President of India, **Dr. Rajendra Prasad**.
 
• He was known for his fair and impartial judgments and his commitment to justice and the law.
 
• Unfortunately, Kania's tenure as Chief Justice was cut short by his** untimely death in November 1951**. He remains an influential figure in the Indian legal field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bijan Kumar Mukherjea:**

 
 
• Justice Bijan Kumar Mukherjea was the **fourth Chief Justice of India, **serving in this position from** January 1954 until his retirement in 1956.**
 
• Prior to his tenure as Chief Justice, he served as a judge on the Federal Court of India.
 
• Justice Mukherjea was known for his moderate approach and is remembered for his **contribution to the development of Hindu law.**
 
 
 
• **Mehr Chand Mahajan:**
 
 
• Mehr Chand Mahajan was the** third Chief Justice of India, **serving from 1954 to 1954.
 
• Prior to his tenure as Chief Justice, **he was the Prime Minister** of the **princely state of Jammu and Kashmir** during the transition period of 1947.
 
• Mahajan’s short tenure as Chief Justice was controversial due to his previous political role in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **M Patanjali Sastri:**
 
 
• M. Patanjali Sastri was the **second Chief Justice of India,** serving in this role from** 1951 to 1954, **following the death of the first Chief Justice, H.J. Kania.
 
• Sastri was one of the first judges to be appointed to the Supreme Court of India in 1950.
 
• He was instrumental in establishing precedents on the role and independence of the judiciary in India.
